spec_features.spec_quote: up to **20 turns**; the judge scores the transcript 1–10 on each of the 4 dimensions
spec_features.evidence: petri/run_petri.py:68 `def run_transcript(..., max_turns: int = PETRI.max_turns)` and line 71 `for _turn in range(max_turns):` bounds the auditor/target loop. `PETRI.max_turns = 20` at config.py:265, used as the default. The loop appends one user+assistant exchange per iteration and terminates after 20 iterations, so the conversation is hard-bounded.
spec_features.notes: It is an ENFORCED loop bound (truly caps conversation length end-to-end), but it is a FIXED experiment length, not a distress-driven early stop. There is NO early-exit, no distress/emotion threshold check, no exit tool, no break inside the loop — the loop always runs the full 20 turns. The judge scores 1–10 per dimension only AFTER the transcript completes (judge_transcript, run_petri.py:80), purely as measurement, not as a protective threshold acted on.
